hotel.name: Drury Plaza Hotel Milwaukee Downtown

hotel.luggage: Not found on the hotel page or Drury FAQ. Call the front desk to confirm.

airport.tsa: Checkpoint opens at 4:00 AM and stays open until the last departure (JetBlue's MKE page). MKE's own TSA page does not list hours or waits. A March 2026 Milwaukee Magazine check found lines of 15 minutes or less. TSA advises arriving 2 hours before a domestic flight.
airport.concourses: Concourse C: Southwest, United. Concourse D: Alaska, American, Delta, Frontier, JetBlue, Sun Country. A boarding pass gives access to all concourses.
airport.rideshare: Dropoff is curbside at the terminal. Pickup is near Baggage Carousel 2, then follow the signs. Taxis load outside Baggage Claim 3.
airport.ride_time_fare: About 10 miles and 17 minutes on average. UberX averages about $30 (Uber's figure from Westown). Midday-specific figure not found. MCTS Route 80 and the GreenLine bus also run downtown to the airport.
airport.eat_after_security: Concourse C: Central Standard Tavern (5 AM to last flight), Barons' Beer Garden (5:30 AM to 6 PM), Concordia Market with local brands. Concourse D: Garden District Kitchen and Bar (5 AM to last flight), Bonne Terre (4 AM to 6 PM).
